trigger: Any post-exclusion conservative employer/template group count below its frozen time target, or any frozen supplemental path allocation shortfall.
extension_method: Continue the same deterministic bottom-k order within every time stratum using the cached projection and compact Records index. Do not change period targets or borrow from another period.
failure_rule: If the 520-per-period frame still has any frozen target/path shortfall, stop and report the actual shortfall; do not publish a nominal 1000-row pack.
preservation: The initial 2080-row candidate pool, frame report, and failed empty pack directory are retained with pool260/failed260 names for audit.
